messages:
Kayla: FYI running into a frustrating SDK parity edge in the Go SDK -> sampleapp rerank flow. Batching helper is rounding up to next multiple of 512, so we end up sending 1536-length vectors to a 1024 model.
Devon: Oof. Is that only the batching helper or the encoder too?
Kayla: Looks helper-only. Encoder emits 1024, then helper pads to 1536 when batch_size triggers pad_to_multiple. Python and JS helpers pad differently so tests passed in CI but Go failed in integration.
Priya: Can you paste the error you see in the reranker?
Kayla: Reranker stack: IndexError at scorer.py:87 when slicing arrays. Quick snippet: 
```
ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 1572864 into shape (8,1024)
```
This is from the consumer expecting shape (8,1024) after unbatching.
Luis: Two things to do: (1) short-term repo patch to make helper pad_to_model_dim not pad_to_multiple, (2) long-term add strict server validation returning 400+error_code EMBEDDING_DIM_MISMATCH.
Devon: Also spotted a subtle one: response entries from the embed endpoint were sometimes reordered by the load-balancer healthcheck patch (id comes after embedding in some nodes). The sampleapp mapped by index assuming stable order. That combination caused silent misalignments.
Priya: Repro script (quick):
```
# tools/repro_go_parity.sh
go run ./samples/repro_embed.go --model redwood-embed-1 --batch 8  # prints len(vec) from helper
# expected: 1024, observed: 1536
```
Kayla: Short PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/89 fixes helper pad logic and adds a debug log of original_dim -> final_dim. Hoping to get quick review.
Luis: We should also add an SDK integration test that verifies embed.dim == model.dim for several simulated models (512,1024,2048) across all languages. Add alert metric embedding.dim.mismatch.counter.
Devon: On the auth side, noticed a token refresh race: when token expired mid-batch we retry the entire batch without idempotency key, causing duplicate rerank actions and noisy downstream costs. Need idempotency support for /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank.
Priya: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2456 linking to sampleapp logs. Marking as P1 for DX squad.
infra-bot: staging deploy queued at 02:00 UTC.
devex: Thanks, assigning to Kayla (owner) and Luis (metrics). Action items: add pad_to_model_dim change to Go SDK, add server-side EMBEDDING_DIM_MISMATCH 400, add idempotency header on embed/rerank, add integration test matrix.
Kayla: Will follow up with canary results once staging runs. Also will add a compatibility note to the SDK migration docs so teams know about pad_to_multiple -> pad_to_model_dim change.
Luis: If anyone hits a live token double-send please ping #incidents and include the idempotency header missing example from logs.
Kayla: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — will update when PR merges and when canary is green.
